candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: EnvHD faithful hand-painted environment texture, Queen Fury cut284 foreground6 cargo cages.
Input images: Image1 is the authoritative original reference for object identity, geometry, marks and exposure. Image2 is the current HD edit target. Edit Image2 only, using Image1 to correct the identified mismatch.
Primary request: Correct only the cage lattice and exposure. Restore the original closely spaced fine crossing mesh with its diagonal ribs, as visible in Image1. The current Image2 has invented heavy widely spaced orthogonal bars, a few big square cells and sharp bright rims: replace those with the original fine dense lattice directions and subdued dark wooden surfaces. Preserve the exact stacks, perspective, individual crate frames, visible top planes, overlapping silhouettes, cropped upper-right cage fragment and separate small tan lower-right fitting. Mesh must read as many delicate crossing strands at original pitch, not oversized iron prison bars.
Style: restrained hand-painted modern HD environment art; preserve existing painted quality and original game intent.
Canvas: exact full original canvas width:height 98:80 (1.22500000 aspect ratio). Keep this full canvas and all relative feature positions. Fill the complete frame without recentering, added margins, crop, inset, padding or change of perspective.
Transparency: actual transparent background around the exact source silhouette and holes; preserve all original transparency. No black painted backdrop, checkerboard, scene background, text, watermark, border or labels.
Invariants: change only the requested features; all other geometry, layout and material colours remain unchanged. Image1 always controls ambiguous details; do not invent structure from low-resolution marks.
